'''Moran''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] stationed on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] around [[3640 BBY]]<ref name="Time">{{TOR dates|4}}</ref>.

==Biography==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
During the [[Battle of Ilum]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Prejad]], [[Shados]], and [[Wenom]] slaughtered a [[Forward alien camp|forward camp]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] alien allies. Normally, Master Moran would not resort to payment in kind, but it was clear the Sith Lords would not negotiate, so he had to ask a group of Republic heroes for assistance in defeating them. The heroes smoked out and defeated the Sith Lords one by one,<ref name="Darkness on Ilum">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Darkness on Ilum|Ilum}}</ref> while also eliminating their forces, releasing alien captives and obtaining [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] battle plans<ref name="Alien Extraction">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Alien Extraction|Ilum}}</ref>.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Master Moran appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a quest giver for a heroic mission ''Darkness on Ilum''. The mission is intended for a group of at least two players and can be skipped, as well as its bonus mission ''Alien Extraction''. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means both missions are completed.
